tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The page itself. Never put text directly on it without a surface behind it in dense views.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the sticky header, table bodies. The default ground for content.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas inside a surface: code blocks, pills, metric tiles, hover rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every structural border: card edges, table rules, input outlines, the header rule.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary division inside a component, where a full line would be too loud. Tree indent guides, group separators.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings. Meets 4.5:1 on surface and bg in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: field labels, inactive tabs, table cell text, supporting copy.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: De-emphasised metadata: counts, version strings, column headers, disclosure arrows. Not for body text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single action colour. Primary buttons, links, the active tab underline, focus rings.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed states of a primary button. Never used as a resting fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active pills, informational banners. A tint, never a text colour.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons sitting on accent-soft.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success state: the rule on a success banner, a healthy indicator.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: The fill behind a success message or badge.

tokens.name: ok-ink
tokens.usage: Text sitting on ok-soft.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Caution: the rule on a warning banner, a degraded indicator, an unresolved value.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: The fill behind a warning message or badge.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Text sitting on warn-soft. In light this is the same hue as warn, which is deliberate: the tint is pale enough to carry it.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Error and failure: the rule on an error banner, a failed check.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: The fill behind an error message or badge.

tokens.name: bad-ink
tokens.usage: Text sitting on bad-soft.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring. Always the accent, so keyboard focus is never ambiguous against a state colour.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The one title in the app header. One per screen.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Card and section headings. Set in uppercase with ink-subtle, which is what makes dense screens scannable.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: A heading inside a card or a widget title.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text and tree rows.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Controls: buttons, inputs, tabs, banner text. The workhorse size.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels above an input, pill text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Supporting detail below a control, counts, version strings.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Table column headers and widget type tags, set uppercase. The smallest text the system allows.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, textareas holding raw content, identifiers shown at full size.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Inline keys and identifiers inside dense rows, where the surrounding text is caption or micro.

spacing.note: A 2px base. Dense tools need the small steps far more than the large ones, so the scale is weighted to the bottom.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: between a tab and its neighbour, inside a tree row.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight internal padding, badge gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside a pill, gap between inline controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The default gap between related elements. Grid gutters in a widget.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Banner padding, button vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding inside a small surface, gap between stacked fields.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Card padding and the gap between cards. The most common step.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter, header padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Separation between major regions of a screen.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Bottom padding on a scrolling page, so the last card is not flush to the edge.

radius.note: Four steps. Smaller surfaces get smaller radii, so nesting never looks like concentric rings.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, banners inside a widget, heat cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Widgets, tiles, code blocks inside a dense panel.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, page-level code blocks, table row hover.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards. The outermost container on a page.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and counts only.
